notes.title: July 19th, 2021 Update
notes.content:
Black Powder Red Earth 8-Bit War ISR Update

The most player-requested feature for 8-Bit War is now up and running. New controls allow gamers to set the movement animation speeds of both assaulters and opponents independently from the options menu. Choose from 1x, 2x 5x or MAX speeds, to determine a pace of play that suits your style!

In addition, players have the option to skip both opponent and friendly movement in-game by tapping the spacebar to fast-forward that unit to its designated final grid, with the game only returning to 1x speed to resolve combat actions.

Look for further quality of life improvements to Black Powder Red Earth 8-Bit War in the coming months as we continue to improve the game.

notes.title: ROADMAP
notes.content:
0300. Drones fill the airspace over the war-torn capital city of Awbari. In the sprawl below, small unit kill teams from private military contractor Cold Harbor carry-out targeted killings of jihadist extremists in the name of the failing state's current dictatorship. An unending war between the lines, punctuated by suppressed muzzle reports and suicide vests clacking off in the pitch black.

After more than 3 years of development, [b]Black Powder Red Earth 8-bit War[/b] is 120 days from completion. This is the roadmap.

[b]Next 30 days[/b]
Design Team Ember will drop [b]Cevian Signature[/b] — the sixth and final operations area for the game.

[b]Next 60 days[/b]
Tutorial will be complete. It should be done sooner, but 60 days for sure.

[b]Next 90 days[/b]
All foley and sound effects will be replaced with a completely redesigned package that was completed in October, 2020.

[b]Next 120 days[/b]
A campaign was never part of the original plan but by popular demand, we've got one coming. 

[b]Hypernotes Ember + Steam Key Bundle[/b]
With the completion of our project drawing near, _Echelon Software is launching a package on our website that pairs an all-in-one Steam key for Windows, Mac and Linux (priced 30% off) with our hardcover art + lore book, Black Powder Red Earth® Hypernotes Ember.

Hypernotes Ember is hardcover bound, full color, made-in-USA book with over 40 pages of fully illustrated background info plus an original 50 page short story comic. Crafted with the assistance of the same special operations combat veterans who helped create the Black Powder Red Earth® Yemen mini-series, Hypernotes Ember is deep dive into the world of BPRE detailing factions, weapon systems, PPE, unit organizations and a comprehensive background history of the failing state of Awbari!

Pick up the package today at https://www.blackpowderredearth.com/games.php
